content.text:
I removed the Friday 15:00 start cutoff from `src/solution.py`. That meant deleting the Friday-specific limit and the weekday check that applied it. Fridays now follow the same rules as every other day: 09:00–17:00 working hours, no overlap with events, and 15-minute start increments. The function name and signature are the same. I didn't run or write any checks.

I left everything else alone, including the existing input validation. That means the 15-minute minimum duration and the `YYYY-MM-DD` date format are unchanged, even though the current requirements don't mention them. The code also still doesn't filter out past times or past days (c_4 and c_5). I didn't add that because it's outside this withdrawal.
